reviews.review: The campaign is pretty decent and there is a fair amount of replay value in the custom matches. I bought it to play solo and wasn't disappointed, though I did have to use a couple mods to make the NPC teammates not suck. By default they look and behave like retarded mannequins but with the "Human Bots OP" mod they're actually an asset and don't hold you back. The immersion also isn't broken since they look like actual marines. I also used the "Better and More Durable Sentries" mod for harder difficulties and found it quite useful. If you like the movies you'll probably enjoy this.
